rule: A reply (turn) has one explicit lifecycle. Every turn gets a generation id when it starts (send, retry, think harder, re-verify retry, auto resume); the chat has at most one live generation and the app one live reply. The transition table is the only writer of reply state and of Message.statusRaw. Any engine, gate or tool event whose generation is not the live one (a stale id, or a generation that already ended) changes nothing: ignore: stale generation. A plain turn writes its reply row with statusRaw=interrupted before the request goes out and rewrites it once, when it ends; a think-harder turn writes nothing until its outcome. A row still reading interrupted when no generation owns it (always so at launch) is a turn that did not finish: marker.didntFinish + retry, never an automatic re-ask after a launch. Markers are ids; their words are not decided here. Decided 2026-11-06.

sentBeforeConfirmed.recordKey: <attestation record fetchedAt, epoch ms>|<nonce> (Android: gatewayNonce, else gpuNonce)
sentBeforeConfirmed.nil: the send went out over a confirmed record, or unsealed
sentBeforeConfirmed.rule: Set when the gate lets a sealed request go before its attestation record is confirmed: pending = the record's verdicts were still pending (the user confirmed at the settle timeout); failed = the user sent anyway over a soft failure that kept the seal. Written on the question and on its reply row at gatePassed/confirm. The reply machine never changes it afterwards; the trust layer resolves it per record (sentBeforeConfirmedResolution). The E2EE claim (report, counters) counts a row only when it is nil.

markers.marker.didntFinish: the turn did not finish (killed, background time ran out, GPU lost) or failed; shown with retry
markers.marker.stopped: the user stopped the turn or declined to send
markers.marker.cutShort: the reply is incomplete: length / content filter / on-device cap / stream closed without [DONE]
markers.marker.decryptFailed: a sealed field did not decrypt; nothing of the reply is shown

sentBeforeConfirmedResolution.rule: A trust-layer writer, not the reply machine. When the verdict of the record named by recordKey settles: pass rewrites every 'pending|<recordKey>' to nil; a hard fail rewrites it to 'failed|<recordKey>'. An unsettled or soft outcome changes nothing. Rows of other records, nil rows and 'failed|' rows are never touched. Losing the attestation capability (an unknown tier resolving to third-party) is not a verdict: it is unsettled, the mark stays pending and the reply is not counted as E2EE.

composerReturn.rule: Where a returned question lands. Composer empty: it takes the question's text and images. Composer has a draft: text = question text + blank line + draft text; images = the question's, then the draft's not already among them (same bytes = same image). No image is ever dropped: over the composer's image limit every image is kept and the composer is over its limit (overLimit = count > limit): send is disabled and the composer shows its existing too-many-images note until enough images are removed. The same state follows a provider switch that lowers the limit. A whitespace-only draft counts as empty. Image bytes survive unchanged.

idle.doc: the chat has no live reply and has not had one in this process

gating.doc: send accepted; the question is saved; prepareTurn and the send gate run; nothing on the wire yet

awaitingConfirm.doc: the gate asked the user (verdicts still pending at the settle timeout, or a soft state); nothing on the wire

requesting.doc: the request is out, or the on-device engine is loading/prefilling; no visible text since the last request began

streaming.doc: visible text has arrived for this generation

toolRunning.doc: a tool round (web search) is executing for this generation

complete.doc: the model said it finished (finish_reason stop, or [DONE] with none) and there is visible text

stopped.doc: the user stopped it (stop button, or declined the gate's question); what was shown is kept

cutOff.doc: finish_reason length or content_filter, the on-device answer cap, or a stream that ended with neither [DONE] nor a finish_reason

failed.doc: an error, a gate refusal, or a finish with no visible text; in session the last-request card shows the error; the partial is not kept (as today)

decryptFailed.doc: a sealed field (content, reasoning, tool name or arguments) did not decrypt; ciphertext is never shown or kept

interrupted.doc: the turn could not finish: app killed, iOS ended background time, or the on-device engine lost the GPU in the background

restored.also: a retry-family generation that ended before its request went out while the reply it would replace still has content
restored.doc: a think-harder generation that did not produce a reply: nothing was written, the old reply stands

discarded.doc: the generation's row was deleted (retry of its question, or the chat was deleted mid-answer)

returned.doc: the user declined the gate's question on a fresh send: the unsent question and its reply row are deleted and the question goes back to the composer (composerReturn); nothing persisted, no marker

send.doc: the composer's send; carries the new generation id and how many images the question carries (default 0)

draftEdited.doc: the user typed in the composer; the draft belongs to the composer, no reply transition takes it

retry.doc: ask a question again; `replaces` = the generations whose rows follow the question and are deleted

thinkHarder.doc: ask again at high effort; `supersedes` = the reply rows that stay until this generation's outcome

reverifyRetry.doc: the retry a re-verify schedules; `captured` = the chat's latest generation id when it was scheduled

autoResume.doc: raised on return to the foreground when this chat's resume is armed (on-device turn abandoned in the background)

gatePassed.doc: the send gate let the request go; sentBeforeConfirmed is null unless the record was not confirmed

gateNeedsConfirm.doc: the gate asks the user before sending (confirmPending / soft degrade)

gateWouldGoPlain.doc: the turn started while the provider was attestable (attested or unknown tier) and, at the gate or at confirm, the send would now leave unsealed (no peer, or the tier resolved to third-party): nothing is sent

gateRefused.doc: the gate refused (no key, unsealed send under an E2EE promise, hard evidence); nothing was sent

confirm.doc: the user chose to send from the gate's question

decline.doc: the user answered the gate's question without sending: trigger = wait | dontSend | dismiss | reverify (Re-verify in the alert answers the ask by declining it first); all behave the same. Never tied to whether the alert is still on screen. After a reverify decline of a retry-family turn the app keeps that retry pending: a later send anyway resends it as a new retry (the reply it replaces stays until that request goes out)

firstToken.doc: first visible text of the generation; the think-harder display swap happens here

toolRound.doc: the model asked for a tool round

toolResult.doc: a tool returned; `sources` = how many sources it adds to this generation

toolRoundEnded.doc: the tool round is over; the follow-up request begins

finish.doc: the stream ended with the last finish_reason seen: stop | length | contentFilter | none ([DONE] with no finish_reason); on-device cap = length

streamEndedWithoutDone.doc: clean EOF with neither [DONE] nor any finish_reason; the transport must not invent a [DONE]

decryptFailed.doc: a sealed field failed to decrypt (content | reasoning | toolName | toolArguments)

error.doc: the turn failed (network, HTTP, invalidEndpoint, imageRefused, ...)

engineAbandoned.doc: the transport gave up on a decode (backgrounded | drainTimeout); never the reply's outcome by itself

engineLateCallback.doc: any callback (sources, queries, toolEnded, success debug info, search offer) delivered after its generation ended

backgroundTimeExpired.doc: iOS ended the background task (remote turn)

appKilled.doc: process death (kill, jetsam, crash); no code runs, nothing is written

launchRecovery.doc: on launch, a chat whose reply row reads interrupted is read back; idempotent, writes nothing

deleteChat.doc: the chat was deleted while its reply was live

staleRule.engineEvents: category engine or gate, or confirm/decline: ignored unless payload.generation == the live generation
staleRule.reverifyRetry: ignored unless payload.captured == the highest generation id this chat has started
staleRule.noRow: an event with no row for (state, event, when) changes nothing

ops.newGeneration: live = payload.generation; highest = max(highest, it); context = {place, supersedes: payload.supersedes ?? [], text: '', sources: 0, sentBeforeConfirmed: null}; resumeArmed = false
ops.retireLive: end the live generation first: a think harder or an unsent retry writes nothing; any other turn ends stopped (row = stopped, text so far)
ops.writeLiveRow: plain turn only (supersedes empty): row[live] = {statusRaw: interrupted, content: '', sources: 0, sentBeforeConfirmed: null}
ops.returnQuestion: userTurns -= 1; delete the question row; returned += live; the composer takes the question back (composerReturn)
ops.persistQuestion: userTurns += 1; context.images = payload.images ?? 0; the composer's draft is consumed
ops.sendRequest: an unsent retry first deletes its replaces rows and writes row[live] = {interrupted, '', 0, sentBeforeConfirmed}; then requests += {generation: live, images: context.images}
ops.setSentBeforeConfirmed: context.sentBeforeConfirmed = payload.sentBeforeConfirmed; copy to row[live] if it exists
ops.kill: live = null; nothing is written (the process is gone; the store keeps what was last written)
ops.end: an unsent retry that is not restored first deletes its replaces rows. Then, by the target state's persist: kept -> row[live] = {statusRaw, content (textSoFar = context.text, empty = ''), sources: context.sources, sentBeforeConfirmed}; and for complete/cutOff of a think harder, delete the supersedes rows; untouched -> nothing; deleted -> delete row[live]. Then live = null

guards.supersedes: the live generation is a think harder (payload.supersedes was non-empty)
guards.place: payload.place of the live generation: remote | local
guards.reason: payload.reason is one of the listed values
guards.origin: the event that started the live generation: send | retry | thinkHarder | reverifyRetry | autoResume
guards.unsentRetry: the live generation is a retry, re-verify retry or auto-resume whose request has not gone out
guards.restorable: unsentRetry, and a row it replaces has non-whitespace content and a statusRaw other than interrupted, failed or decryptFailed

vectors.name: G1/late-callbacks-after-stop
vectors.summary: the stopped turn's engine is still running; its sources and tool callbacks arrive after a new send and must not touch the new reply

vectors.name: G2/retry-overlap-keeps-the-new-turn-live
vectors.summary: retry while a reply streams: the old task's end must not clear the new turn's busy state (generatingThreadID)

vectors.name: G2/think-harder-over-think-harder
vectors.summary: a second think harder while the first streams keeps superseding the original reply; one reply survives

vectors.name: G3/killed-mid-turn-reads-didnt-finish
vectors.summary: kill mid-answer: the row written before the request still reads interrupted at launch; marker + retry, no auto re-ask, no orphan question

vectors.name: G3/stopped-partial-is-saved-as-stopped
vectors.summary: a user stop keeps what was shown, saved as stopped, not as a normal reply

vectors.name: G3/config-error-is-not-a-reply
vectors.summary: an invalid server address used to be saved as the reply text; it is a failed turn with no content

vectors.name: G3/empty-reply-is-failed
vectors.summary: a finish with no visible text is never saved as a blank reply

vectors.name: G4/finish-length-is-cut-short
vectors.summary: finish_reason length keeps the text and marks it cut short

vectors.name: G4/eof-without-done-is-cut-short
vectors.summary: a stream that closes with neither [DONE] nor a finish_reason is cut short; no synthetic [DONE]

vectors.name: G4/finish-stop-without-done-is-complete
vectors.summary: control: finish_reason stop then EOF without [DONE] is complete (the model said it finished)

vectors.name: G5/reasoning-decrypt-failure-is-not-the-reply
vectors.summary: sealed reply whose reasoning does not decrypt and whose content is empty: never ciphertext as the reply

vectors.name: G5/content-decrypt-failure-mid-stream
vectors.summary: a content chunk that does not decrypt after text arrived: the decrypted part is dropped too

vectors.name: G6/reverify-retry-never-deletes-a-newer-turn
vectors.summary: a re-verify scheduled for turn 1 lands after the user sent turn 2; it is dropped instead of deleting turn 2

vectors.name: G6/reverify-retry-of-the-latest-turn-runs
vectors.summary: control: with no newer turn the scheduled retry runs

vectors.name: G7/cap-then-drain-timeout-is-cut-short-not-background
vectors.summary: on-device answer cap, then the native drain times out: cut short, no auto re-ask

vectors.name: G7/abandoned-decode-search-stays-out-of-the-next-turn
vectors.summary: backgrounded on-device turn is abandoned and resumed; the abandoned decode's web search lands during the resumed turn and is dropped

vectors.name: G7/no-tool-round-after-stop
vectors.summary: a tool round the stopped decode asks for afterwards starts nothing

vectors.name: G7/a-stopped-turns-late-tool-call-runs-nothing-in-the-next-turn
vectors.summary: a stopped on-device turn's decode asks for a tool round after the next turn started: ignored as stale, no search runs, the next turn's sources and chip stay unchanged

vectors.name: lifecycle/killed-in-background-does-not-auto-resume
vectors.summary: armed on-device resume does not survive the process; launch shows the marker and waits for the user

vectors.name: lifecycle/remote-background-time-expired-is-interrupted
vectors.summary: iOS ends the background task of a remote turn: interrupted, not a user stop, no auto resume

vectors.name: lifecycle/send-while-live-keeps-the-draft
vectors.summary: a send while a reply is live is refused and the draft stays (Android cleared it)

vectors.name: lifecycle/send-anyway-answers-the-gated-question
vectors.summary: send a question with 2 images, the gate asks (still checking), the user types a newer draft, then sends anyway: the request answers the gated question with its images and the draft stays

vectors.name: lifecycle/retry-with-previous-reply-restores
vectors.summary: retry, the gate asks, the user declines: the reply they already had stands as it was

vectors.name: lifecycle/retry-after-failed-stops
vectors.summary: retry of a failed reply, then decline: nothing to restore, so the failed row goes and the retry reads stopped

vectors.name: lifecycle/reverify-with-reply-restores
vectors.summary: a re-verify retry of the latest turn is declined: its complete reply stands as it was

vectors.name: lifecycle/autoresume-after-interrupted-stops
vectors.summary: the auto re-ask of an interrupted on-device turn is declined: an interrupted partial is not a reply to restore

vectors.name: lifecycle/reverify-during-the-ask-never-wedges-the-chat
vectors.summary: Re-verify in the still-checking alert declines the held-back turn (its question returns to the composer); the chat is not left with a live turn, so the next send goes

vectors.name: lifecycle/reverify-on-a-retry-keeps-it-pending
vectors.summary: Re-verify on a held retry declines it (the reply the user had stands) and keeps the retry pending; a later send anyway resends it, and only then is the old reply replaced

vectors.name: lifecycle/a-turn-started-attestable-never-goes-plain
vectors.summary: window A: the tier resolves to third-party between prepareTurn and the gate, with no ask; the send would leave unsealed, so nothing is sent and the question returns to the composer

vectors.name: lifecycle/confirm-for-a-sealed-send-never-goes-plain
vectors.summary: window B: the user agreed to send anyway (still encrypted), then the tier resolved to third-party; confirm re-reads and nothing is sent; the question returns

vectors.name: lifecycle/a-retry-started-attestable-keeps-its-reply-instead-of-going-plain
vectors.summary: the same for a retry: nothing is sent and the reply the user had stands

vectors.name: lifecycle/hard-verdict-while-awaiting-confirm-sends-nothing
vectors.summary: a hard verdict lands while the still-checking ask is up and the user taps send: confirm re-reads the gate, nothing is sent, the question returns to the composer

vectors.name: lifecycle/hard-verdict-through-reverify-sends-nothing
vectors.summary: the same hard verdict reached through Re-verify: the ask is declined first, so nothing is sent and the question is back in the composer

vectors.name: lifecycle/hard-verdict-while-awaiting-confirm-restores-a-retry
vectors.summary: a retry asked to confirm, then a hard verdict: nothing is sent and the reply the user had stands

vectors.name: lifecycle/think-harder-stopped-restores-the-old-reply
vectors.summary: a think harder that is stopped writes nothing; the old reply stands

vectors.name: lifecycle/delete-chat-mid-answer-writes-nothing
vectors.summary: deleting the chat mid-answer ends the generation and writes nothing (Android A4)

vectors.name: sentBeforeConfirmed/confirmed-while-pending
vectors.summary: the user confirmed a sealed send while the record's verdicts were pending: the reply carries pending|<recordKey>

vectors.name: sentBeforeConfirmed/sent-over-a-failed-soft-check
vectors.summary: send anyway (still encrypted) after the record's check failed softly: failed|<recordKey>

vectors.name: lifecycle/decline-wait-returns-the-question
vectors.summary: the gate asks (still checking) and the user picks wait: the unsent question and its reply row go, the question and its 2 images return to the composer beside the draft; nothing persisted, no marker

vectors.name: lifecycle/decline-dont-send-returns-the-question
vectors.summary: the gate asks (still checking) and the user picks dontSend: the unsent question and its reply row go, the question and its 2 images return to the composer beside the draft; nothing persisted, no marker

vectors.name: lifecycle/decline-dismiss-returns-the-question
vectors.summary: the gate asks (still checking) and the user picks dismiss: the unsent question and its reply row go, the question and its 2 images return to the composer beside the draft; nothing persisted, no marker

platformNotes.note: on-device turns are not abandoned on background (a foreground service keeps the process alive and engine eviction waits for the turn); appBackgrounded/backgroundTimeExpired never fire; process death is appKilled

engineCache.rule: G8: one generation counter (epoch) per cache; evict bumps it. A build that finishes under an older epoch releases its engine and is never inserted. A second request for the same key while a build is in flight joins it.

effects: start a build under the current epoch
join the in-flight build; never a second engine
epoch += 1; the in-flight build will be dropped
epoch += 1; release the engine
insert the engine
release the engine; never insert (ignore: stale epoch)
reuse the resident engine
